biography: Chrissy Palmer, born Christina Palmer in the bustling town of Slough, England, didn't come from racing pedigree. Her father, a lorry driver, and her mother, a nurse, knew nothing of apexes and downforce. Chrissy's racing journey began with a beat-up go-kart she found abandoned in her uncle's garage. By age 10, she was tearing around local karting tracks, much to the surprise of seasoned veterans. Her aggressive style and fearless overtaking maneuvers quickly earned her attention. A defining moment came at the British Karting Championship in 2010, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical failure, she fought her way to victory, showcasing her incredible tenacity. Currently driving for N.Gonçalves Skin in Formula Trainer, Chrissy is determined to prove she has what it takes to reach the highest echelons of motorsport. She is at the peak of her career, aiming to make a lasting impression.
drivingStyle: Chrissy Palmer's driving style is best described as 'controlled aggression'. She attacks corners with a late-braking technique, often pushing the car to the absolute limit of grip. Tire management isn't her strongest suit; she prefers to extract maximum performance from the tires early in a stint, often sacrificing long-run pace for a burst of speed. Under pressure, Chrissy thrives, often pulling off daring overtakes in high-stakes situations. Her flashy style sometimes leads to mistakes, but it also makes her incredibly exciting to watch.
